title: Writing Chemical Formulae
summary: Using valencies and the criss-cross method, including polyatomic ions, to write formulae of compounds.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 9: Atomic Foundations of Matter

objectives: I can write formulae of ionic compounds from valencies.
I can use brackets for polyatomic ions.
I can name compounds from their formulae.
misconceptions: The numbers in a formula can be changed to balance an equation.
Charges appear in the formula of the compound.
